title.narrative: Renewing the Kenyan cashew value chain and improving livelihood of 30,000 farmers in coastal regions

description.narrative:
The Integra Foundation is a Slovakia based international relief and development agency, active since 1995. Their current focus is on humanitarian relief and economic development programs in Ethiopia, Kenya, South Sudan, Syria and Yemen. They also respond to international crises around the world through our membership in the Integral Alliance.
This four-year project aims to renew and strengthen a formerly strong value chain for the export of cashew nuts from Kenya to international markets. Integra aims at enhancing rural livelihoods through the renewal and growth of cashew as a long-term and significant cash crop for 30,000 farmers, with a particular focus on attracting women and youth farmers and participants in Kenya.
